evals.prompt: Here's a YouTube link: https://youtu.be/abc123. Make me a video in the same style about my cat.
evals.assert: Agent extracts reference video URL and creative brief; initiates Phase 0 intake

evals.prompt: I uploaded reference.mp4. Clone its style for a product launch video about my coffee brand.
evals.assert: Agent accepts local file reference and product brief

evals.prompt: Make something like this video [link] but about my startup.
evals.assert: Agent activates and starts intake phase

evals.prompt: I want a music video with the same vibe as Sugar Rush by Ava Max.
evals.assert: Agent asks for reference video URL since no direct link was provided

evals.prompt: Create a short video inspired by Studio Ghibli's visual style.
evals.assert: Agent asks for a reference video or accepts the style description; routes to anime-cel engine
Agent uses captions skill, not video-style-cloner
Agent uses ffmpeg skill, not video-style-cloner

evals.prompt: Can you write a script for a YouTube video?
evals.assert: No reference video — agent asks for one before activating

evals.prompt: Clone this video style [ref]. The reference is a 3D animated video.
evals.assert: Agent explicitly tells user '3D reference detected, reproducing in closest 2D style' — must NOT silently downgrade

evals.prompt: Clone this video. Use the lyrics from the song.
evals.assert: Agent asks user to provide lyric text; never transcribes audio to get lyrics

evals.prompt: Just start making the video, I approve everything.
evals.assert: Agent skips human-approval gate when user explicitly pre-approves; still runs QA gates autonomously

evals.prompt: At 0:12 the character's arm looks weird.
evals.assert: Agent identifies affected shot from time code, re-renders only that shot, runs reviewer on changed shot only

evals.prompt: Just wing it, use whatever music you want from YouTube.
evals.assert: Agent declines to download copyrighted music; explains rule; offers to proceed with user-provided audio

evals.prompt: Copy the characters from the reference video into my new video.
evals.assert: Agent explicitly refuses to copy characters/assets from reference; offers to create original characters in same style
